newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures firmer in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures firmer in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were firmer in after-hours trade on Friday, as sporadic buying helped prices recover from early lows, traders said.
Prices ranged from flat to 0.8 yen per kg higher than the day"s close. Benchmark July was up 0.2 yen at 155.7 yen.
Volume was thin with 5,107 lots traded.

During the day, prices edged down in a continued technical correction, traders said. "Weaker prices in rubber-producing countries reflected slack demand and prompted local investors to take profits," one trader said. "We are watching to see how far the correction will continue," he said.
